_comment: Albums' listing in Kayden's Source (apps.kaydenpmd.net), which is built from Ammy's repo. publish-source.yml puts this 'app' block together with the source-wide settings in Ammy's own source.config.json, then runs Ammy's scripts/build_source.py against Ammy's public/source.json. Everything here is re-applied on every release, so a fix here goes live with the next one. appPermissions has to list every entitlement in the app and its share extension: AltStore refuses to install an app whose source didn't declare one, and SideStore would too if the source ever set "version": 2 (SideStore checks only sources with version >= 2, and Kayden's Source has no version key).
